newsitem.title: USA: Clinton makes South Dakota eligible for storm aid.
newsitem.headline: Clinton makes South Dakota eligible for storm aid.

text.p: President Clinton Friday declared a major disaster exists in South Dakota and ordered federal aid to help recovery efforts in an area struck by a winter storm in November 1996.

Clinton's action made federal funding available to local governments in a 10-county area hit hard by a severe winter storm. The counties include Butte, Harding, Hutchinson, Lake, Meade, Minnehaha, Moody, Pennington, Perkins and Turner.
